title: Audit European opcode 39 action 13 sources
changes: Document the conditional source ownership of the two opcode-39 special-branch instructions separately from the newly integrated low-selector model.
validation: Static index audit wnmiows2 authenticates the EUR ROM and E164 manifest, finding ten physical index cells already owned by normal-battle, alternate-battle and equipment resources. Target graph audit 4p7yr_3v finds five referenced sequences, four OBJ lists and sixteen pixel blocks fully covered by existing sources.
limitations: The audit assumes valid unchanged unit and actor assignments, supported facing and no unresolved override; it does not establish original task execution or ordinary reachability. Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
